settings.name_in_paper: Model A: Clustered items and statistically identical users
unmapped: n items and m users; in each round a user drawn uniformly at random from m users arrives (observed)
no-repetition constraint: an item cannot be recommended twice to the same user
items are randomly assigned to one of K unknown clusters (prob alpha_k) when first recommended; success rate depends on item cluster only
regime m >= n, T = o(mn), log(m) = o(n)
the learner (ECT) knows the number of item clusters K
settings.definition_quote: Model A. Clustered items and statistically identical users. In this case, $\rho_{iu}$ depends on the item $i$ only. Items are classified into $K$ clusters ... $R^\pi(T) = Tp_1 -\sum_{t=1}^T \mathbb{E}[\sum_{k=1}^K\indicator_{\{ i^\pi_t\in {\cal I}_k\} }p_k]$.

settings.name_in_paper: Model B: Unclustered items and statistically identical users (satisficing regret)
unmapped: large reservoir of n items whose success rates are drawn i.i.d. from unknown absolutely continuous distribution zeta on [0,1]
satisficing regret relative to the (1-epsilon)-quantile mu_{1-epsilon}
random user arrivals among m users with no-repetition constraint; regime m >= n, T = o(mn)
action space is a finite set of n items but effectively a reservoir (finite_K used loosely)
settings.definition_quote: Model B. Unclustered items and statistically identical users. ... its success rate $\rho_i$ is drawn according to some distribution $\zeta$ over $[0,1]$ ... $R_\varepsilon^\pi (T) = \sum_{t=1}^T \mathbb{E}[ \max \{ 0, \mu_{1-\varepsilon} - \rho_{i^\pi_t} \} ]$.

settings.name_in_paper: Model C: Clustered items and clustered users
unmapped: users in L unknown clusters (prob beta_l), items in K unknown clusters (prob alpha_k); success rate p_{kl}
best item cluster k*_l unique for each user cluster
random user arrivals with no-repetition constraint; regime m >= n, T = o(mn)
the learner knows the numbers of item clusters K and user clusters L
settings.definition_quote: Model C. Clustered items and clustered users. ... $\rho_{iu}=p_{k\ell}$ when $i\in {\cal I}_k$ and $u\in {\cal U}_\ell$ ... $R^\pi(T) = T\sum_{\ell}\beta_\ell p_{k^\star_\ell\ell} -\sum_{t=1}^T \mathbb{E}[\sum_{k,\ell}\indicator_{\{ u_t \in {\cal U}_\ell, i^\pi_t\in {\cal I}_k\} }p_{k\ell}]$.

symbols.n_bar: E[max_u N_u(T)], expected max number of arrivals of a user
symbols.alpha_k: probability an item belongs to cluster k
symbols.Delta_k: p_1 - p_k gap of item cluster k
symbols.sum_subopt: here: sum over suboptimal item clusters k != 1

conditions: m >= c/Delta_2^2 for some constant c large enough

source.label: th:lowA
source.quote: Let $\pi\in \Pi$ be an arbitrary algorithm. The regret of $\pi$ satisfies: for all $T\ge 1$ such that $m\ge c/\Delta_2^2$ ... $R^\pi(T) \ge \max\{ R_{\mathrm{nr}}(T), R_{\mathrm{ic}}(T) \}$, where ... $R_{\mathrm{nr}}(T) := \overline{n}  \sum_{k\neq 1}\alpha_k\Delta_k$ and $R_{\mathrm{ic}}(T) := {T\over m} \sum_{k\neq 1}\alpha_k \phi(k,m,p)\Delta_k$.

results.notes: Sums are over item clusters, not arms. Horizon labelled known since the lower bound allows knowledge of T.

symbols.p_k: success rate of item cluster k
symbols.p_1: success rate of best item cluster

conditions: pi uniformly good: regret O(max{sqrt(T), log(m)/log(m log(m)/T + e)}) for all (p, alpha) as T,m,n grow with T=o(nm), m>=n

source.label: th:lowA
source.quote: Assume that $\pi$ is uniformly good, then we have: $R^\pi(T)\gtrsim  R_{\mathrm{sp}}(T):=\log(T) \sum_{k\neq 1} {\Delta_k\over 2 \kl (p_k,p_1)}$

symbols.C_z: upper bound on the density of zeta
symbols.epsilon: satisficing threshold (top epsilon fraction of items)

conditions: density of zeta bounded by C
m >= c/epsilon^2 for constant c >= 1 large enough

source.label: th:lowB
source.quote: Assume that the density of $\zeta$ satisfies, for some $C>0$, $\zeta(\mu) \le C$ ... Let $\pi\in \Pi$ be an arbitrary algorithm. Then its satisficing regret satisfies: for all $T\ge 1$ such that $m\ge c/\varepsilon^2$ ... $R_\varepsilon^\pi(T) \ge \max\{ R_{\mathrm{nr}}(T), R_{\mathrm{i}}(T) \}$

symbols.R_nr: n_bar * sum_l beta_l sum_{k != k*_l} alpha_k Delta_{kl}
symbols.R_ic: (T/m) sum_l beta_l sum_{k != k*_l} alpha_k phi(k,l,m,p) Delta_{kl}
symbols.R_uc: m sum_l beta_l (sum_{k in R_l} Delta_{kl} psi(l,k,T,m,p))/K

conditions: m >= c/min_{k,l} Delta_{kl}^2 for some constant c large enough

source.label: th:lowC
source.quote: Let $\pi\in \Pi$ be an arbitrary algorithm. Then its regret satisfies: for all $T\ge 2m$ such that $m\ge c/\min_{k,\ell}\Delta_{k\ell}^2$ ... $R^\pi(T) \ge \max\{ R_{\mathrm{nr}}(T), R_{\mathrm{ic}}(T),R_{\mathrm{uc}}(T) \}$

results.notes: Components defined in symbols; comparator is per-user-cluster best item cluster.

symbols.c_beta_p: value of the LP inf_{n>=0} sum_l beta_l sum_{k!=k*_l} Delta_{kl} n_{kl} s.t. sum_{k!=k*_l} kl(p_{kl},p_{kl'}) n_{kl} >= 1 for all l' in L^perp(l)

conditions: pi uniformly good: per-user regret R_u(N) = o(N^alpha) for all alpha > 0

source.quote: In addition, when $T = \omega(m)$, if $\pi$ is uniformly good, $R^\pi(T)\gtrsim R_{\mathrm{uc}}'(T):=c(\beta,p)m\log(T/m)$

results.notes: Per-user version stated as Theorem 8 in the appendix (liminf R_u/log(T/m) >= c(beta,p)), not recorded separately.

symbols.alpha_k: probability an item is in cluster k
symbols.p_k: success rate of item cluster k

conditions: m >= n, T = o(mn), log(m) = o(n)

source.label: thm:modelBupper
source.quote: Assume that the density of $\zeta$ satisfies $\zeta(\mu)\le C$ for all $\mu\in [0,1]$. For any $\varepsilon  \ge C \sqrt{\frac{\pi}{2\log T}}$, we have: $R^{\mathrm{ET}}_\varepsilon (T) = \set{O}( \overline{N}\frac{ \log(1/\varepsilon) \log\log(m)}{\varepsilon }   + \frac{(\log T)^2}{\varepsilon^2}  )$.

symbols.G_ECUCS: sum_l beta_l (p_{sigma_l(1) l} - p_{sigma_l(K) l}) times the bracketed problem-dependent term of Theorem 6 (constant if L^perp(l) empty for all l, else O(log N_bar))

conditions: unique best item cluster per user cluster

source.label: thm:newalgC
source.quote: For any $\ell$, let $\sigma_\ell$ be the permutation of $[K]$ ... Then, we have: $R^{\mathrm{EC-UCS}}(T) = \set{O} ( m \sum_{\ell} \beta_\ell (p_{\sigma_\ell(1)\ell}- p_{\sigma_\ell(K)\ell}) (\max (\frac{K^{3}\log K}{\phi(\min(y_{\ell r},\delta)^2)}, \frac{\sqrt{K}}{\min_\ell \beta_\ell}) + ...))$.

results.notes: Complex instance-dependent bound summarised through declared symbol G_ECUCS; full expression in expression_latex. phi(x) = x/log(1/x). Conditions m^2 >= T(log T)^3 and T >= m log T stated in text before algorithm.

symbols.sum_subopt: sum over item clusters k != k*_l

source.label: th:Cgen
source.quote: When $m^2\ge T(\log T)^3$, the regret of ECB satisfies: $R^\mathrm{ECB} (T) = \set{O}(  \sum_{\ell=1}^L \beta_\ell m\sum_{k\neq k^\star_\ell} \frac{  \log ( \overline{N} ) }{p_{k^\star_\ell \ell}-p_{k\ell}} )$.

results.notes: ECB runs UCB1 per user over estimated item clusters.
